lado_card.texto: The same fictional company across all five programs. Here you follow Patrícia from the prototype to the handoff to Rafael.

inicio.titulo: AI Mentor: support the builder manager, from prototype to a safe handoff to IT
inicio.lead: Managers are already building their own tools with AI. What's missing is someone to guide them with a method: choose what is worth building, prototype, set limits, test, and hand off to IT with a named owner and a cost. In eight lessons you build that method and leave with a 90-day program plan.
inicio.capa_alt: AI Mentor: a mentor and a sales manager review a prototype on a laptop; the IT technician in the background.
inicio.aulas_sub: One case from start to finish: sales manager Patrícia Lima wants a customer follow-up tool. You guide her through the handoff to Rafael, from IT.

itens: People who want to work helping companies adopt AI, guiding managers who build their own tools.
Area managers and IT leaders who will organize this movement inside the company.
You don't need to code. You need to know the process, ask good questions, and keep the pace.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Filter ideas and turn a process into a one-page spec, with permissions.
Run a prototyping session and write the agent constitution.
Build the test suite, run acceptance testing with the user, and deliver the handoff package to IT.
Measure with three indicators and build a 90-day program with meetings and milestones.
This program is one of the four in Professional 2030. Each program will have an INEMA qualification certificate (not a regulated profession); details soon.
Recommended prerequisite, not required: Common Core — Trusting what AI builds.
Lab company used in all five: Horizonte Distribuidora.
